providerSubstitution.seam: A harness-owned Vitest config aliases only the exact webgpu package import while the pinned upstream GPUSgd implementation and both WGSL shaders remain unchanged.

runtimeOwnershipPlan.incumbentLimitation: The application cannot control the incumbent's pipeline, descriptor, command, synchronization, or readback implementation beneath the WebGPU API.
runtimeOwnershipPlan.applicationConsequence: A material provider-level cost in the complete GPU SGD operation directly reduces throughput for iterative embeddings.

materialOutcome.metric: complete GPUSgd initialization plus 500 two-pass epochs, synchronization, mapped readback, and Float32Array materialization
materialOutcome.decisionRule: Grant runtime ownership credit only if D0 preserves the frozen semantic oracle and exact within-provider replay while beating W0 by at least 1.10x at both selected-operation p50 and p95.

I0.construction: Ambient upstream WebGPU provider with no Doe evidence interpretation.

I1.construction: Pinned webgpu dependency from the exact upstream lockfile.

W0.construction: The pinned incumbent under the same deterministic input, semantic oracle, dispatch, output-byte, timing, and replay contract.

D0.construction: DoeRuntime under the identical deterministic workload and evidence contract.

P0.construction: No incumbent correctness defect exists. A post-hoc performance patch is outside this frozen provider comparison.

fallbackPolicy.providerIdentityAssertion: Every lane must bind its requested provider and a physical adapter with an accessible render node; software adapters fail closed.

workload.sameWorkPolicy: All lanes execute the same pinned GPUSgd TypeScript, unchanged SGD and apply-forces WGSL, deterministic graph, initial embedding, random sequence, 500 epochs, synchronization cadence, and mapped readback.
workload.completionBoundary: Timing begins before GPUSgd.init and ends after all epochs, synchronization, mapped readback, and Float32Array materialization have completed.

performancePolicy.timingScope: GPUSgd.init through deterministic 500-epoch optimization, synchronization, mapped readback, and Float32Array materialization
performancePolicy.throughputMetric: oracle-passing deterministic 500-epoch GPUSgd operations per second
